snippet.query: What is dual SIM eSIM for business?
snippet.exactText: Dual SIM with eSIM for business lets a compatible phone use separate mobile subscriptions for work, personal use or travel. The setup may combine a physical SIM and an eSIM, or supported dual eSIM profiles. Separate lines give you service choices, but they do not automatically separate apps, work data or device-management permissions.
